notes.title: Release 2.0.2.0 - Pride Month 2024
notes.content:
Grandma and that guy with the wizard hat were up all night decorating Edgefield to celebrate pride month 2024. (Yeah, they are a little late, we know, but it was definitely worth the wait!)

Make sure to play during June to see the colorfully decorated Edgefield and get the color changing spell available in the medieval level for free which allows you to change bucket skins to all kind of colorful designs and pride flags.

Be proud! You definitely have every reason to be! ːp2cubeː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450498/c743eeb4dc060fedbb06d07294ddc2fa326134a6.png

Version 2.0.2.0 Patch Notes



New Features

 Added pride flags to every lamp pole in Edgefield
 Painted some road crossings in the colors of the rainbow. These are here to stay
 Added 100% Discount for the color changing spell available in the medieval level


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where for some players the portal cutscene wouldn't play in the right speed
 Fixed a bug that allowed players to drive through the closed barrier and enter the base in level 1 when they already have exited the barrier
 Fixed a bug that allowed the player to drive backwards in the base in level 1 and fall of the map
 Fixed a camera glitch that would occur for some players
 Fixed connection issues with DualSense controllers
 Fixed a pathfinding bug on SteamDeck that resulted in pedestrians glitching through random geometry

notes.title: Release 2.0.1.2 - Winter Update and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Welcome to the garbage crew winter update! A snowstorm has hit Edgefield and everything is cold and frosty now. Maybe after your shift you can build a snowman or drink a hot tea in your break room if your boss allows it.

So use the holliday season to get cozy on your couch with your family and friends and clean up snowy Edgefield! Or, if you are more of a summer type, talk to the snowman in the base to disable winter mode.

Event will run until Jan 31st!

With that out of the way we wish everyone a joyful holiday season! Whether you celebrate Christmas, Hanukkah, Diwali, Kwanzaa, Winter Solstice, or simply enjoy the festive spirit, may this time bring you happiness. To all our community, regardless of holiday traditions, thank you for being part of our gaming family. Happy holidays and here's to a fantastic year ahead!

Release Notes:

New Features:
- Added snow and a overall frosty look to level 1, 2 and the main menu (You can talk to the snowman in the base if you are more of a summer type) Event will last until Jan 31st.

Balancing:
- Decreased the level time for the time machine level
- Increased the garbage truck speed for the time machine level

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug where, when placing a garbage can on its spawn point while the truck is parked in a way that the can is simultaneously attached to the garbage truck, the garbage can softlocked and couldn't be removed from the lifter
- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to exit the screen border by pushing a log against the screen border. This allowed the player to walk on the screen border
- Fixed a bug where when the truck moves quickly garbage is launched everywhere
- Fixed a bug where garbage thrown in truck by hand wasn't counted when throwing from directly behind the truck
- Fixed a bug where when gaining or loosing money no + or - particles were shown in level 2
- Fixed a typo in Discord rich presence when playing single player
- Fixed a visual glitch in the main menu where the how to play videos weren't alligned properly
- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to throw the cat while in store in level 1. This resulted in weird glitches. Cat throwing in the store isn't possible anymore. When you enter the store while throwing the cat is teleported away. No more cat throwing in store! Try me!

Thank you all for reporting these bugs ːp2cubeː
